MicLock keeps the macOS global default input on the MacBook built-in
microphone while AirPods remain the output device.

Highlights:

- Native compact menu-bar app with colored device badges.
- Automatic recovery after AirPods reconnect.
- Command-line controls for selecting, pausing, and resuming the target mic.
- One-step DMG installer and uninstaller.
- Bundled Apple Silicon SwitchAudioSource 1.2.2 and license.

Compatibility: Apple Silicon and macOS Tahoe 26 or later.

Security note: this community build is ad-hoc signed and not Apple-notarized.
Review the source and verify the SHA-256 checksum before installation. On first
launch, Gatekeeper may require Control-clicking MicLock.app and choosing Open.
